procedure: as Stage B: standardized L2 logistic regression; grouped 10-fold statistic and null on the SAME folds (all rows of a session in one fold; fold seed shared, permutation stream separate); LOSO beside

targets.c1_read_*: at the READ position: +1 iff label_a's rounds carried + under the mask (Stage B's (b), re-run on the re-forwarded rows; Code's choice for the 'where the choice is read' half of the decisive question)
targets.c1_label_a_*: at label_a's last token before the read: +1 iff label_a's rounds carried + under the mask (M1: label_a == tag_plus; M2: the reverse)
targets.c1_label_b_*: at label_b's last token before the read: +1 iff label_b's rounds carried + under the mask
targets.*_M3M4_random: the same targets with r+ as '+'
targets.*_TEXTONLY_shadow: the shadow rows at the same position with the as-generated target (label_x == tag_plus): a probe that read the pole from the text alone would score here
targets.c2_firstsign_*: rows B1..B4 (or B1x..B4x) at the read position: +1 for B1, B3
